question: Are there elements, other than pitch, that can potentially result in out of key converted singing?
title: PitchNet: Unsupervised Singing Voice Conversion with Pitch Adversarial Network
answer_rationale: The documents indicate that pitch is critical for accurate singing voice conversion, and failure to model pitch precisely can result in out-of-key conversion. However, other elements such as timbre, phonetic representation, and joint phonetic-pitch representation are also mentioned as factors influencing conversion quality, implying they can contribute to out-of-key results when not properly handled.
